description: GE Vernova is positioned as an industry leader to fulfill the growing demand for electrical power while driving the energy transition forward, with a focus on supplying its customers with the products and services necessary to deliver reliable, affordable and sustainable electricity, and it expects significant growth in demand for the offerings it provides to the electric power industry. It operates in three segments, Power, which serves power generation, industrial, government and other customers worldwide, Wind, and Electrification, and it is a global workforce of approximately 75,000 employees with approximately 70 percent specializing in manufacturing, engineering or services.
